thread_title: S. montana clone D Transylvania Co, NC
breadcrumb: S. montana clone D Transylvania Co, NC

posts.body_html:
Looks like I dropped the ball on this one....here's an old clone that was acquired a long time ago and has survived the test of time! Photos were taken a few months ago and I guess there was some intention to posting them, but I forgot, LOL

clone D is in this picture, which was taken 12 years ago! I lost most of those original clones over time, but a few, like clone D, have survived the test of time. That trait alone makes them worthy of breeding with IMO, montanas aren't easy to keep alive long term.



I should probably get some updated pics of this clump, it has since changed quite a bit color-wise. S. montana clone D Translyvania Co, NC, pics taken 10/22/23:
